image_description: A night-time urban street scene featuring a traffic light pole in the foreground. The pole supports two signal units: an upper circular red light and a lower pedestrian crossing signal displaying a green 'walk' figure. In the background, there is a building facade with illuminated windows and signage, including a partially visible 'Saks' sign and a 'No Standing Anytime' street sign attached to the pole.
